headword: {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}
reading: ちゅうとうきょういく

definitions.gloss: the middle stage of formal schooling that sits between primary and higher education, generally corresponding to junior high school and high school; secondary education
definitions.explanation: The level of formal education between elementary school and university. In the Japanese system, {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく} covers {中学校|ちゅうがっこう} (junior high school, ages 12-15) and {高等学校|こうとうがっこう} (senior high school, ages 15-18). There are also combined {中等教育学校|ちゅうとうきょういくがっこう} that run for six years and teach both stages as one program. The term is used mainly in official education policy documents, statistics, and academic writing; in everyday life people talk about {中学校|ちゅうがっこう} or {高校|こうこう} directly.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}は{六年間|ろくねんかん}だ。
examples.english: Japan's secondary education lasts six years.

examples.japanese: {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}{段階|だんかい}で{進路|しんろ}を{考|かんが}え{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: Students start thinking about their future careers at the secondary education stage.

examples.japanese: {初等教育|しょとうきょういく}と{中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}の{連携|れんけい}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Coordination between primary and secondary education is important.

examples.japanese: {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}を{修了|しゅうりょう}した{時点|じてん}で{就職|しゅうしょく}する{人|ひと}も{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: There are also quite a few people who get a job at the point where they finish secondary education.

notes:
Composed of {中等|ちゅうとう} (middle level, intermediate) + {教育|きょういく} (education). Part of a three-part set of terms that divide formal schooling by level: {初等|しょとう} (primary) → {中等|ちゅうとう} (secondary) → {高等|こうとう} (higher / tertiary).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}を{受|う}ける: to receive secondary education
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}{学校|がっこう}: combined secondary school (6-year junior+senior high)
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}{機関|きかん}: secondary education institution
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}{段階|だんかい}: the secondary education stage
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}の{課程|かてい}: the secondary education curriculum

THE THREE STAGES OF EDUCATION:
- {初等教育|しょとうきょういく}: primary education — elementary school ({小学校|しょうがっこう}), grades 1-6.
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}: secondary education — junior high ({中学校|ちゅうがっこう}) + senior high ({高等学校|こうとうがっこう}), grades 7-12.
- {高等教育|こうとうきょういく}: higher / tertiary education — university ({大学|だいがく}), graduate school ({大学院|だいがくいん}), junior college, etc.

RELATED WORDS:
- {義務教育|ぎむきょういく}: compulsory education — in Japan, this covers elementary school plus lower secondary ({中学校|ちゅうがっこう}), i.e. nine years total. Upper secondary ({高校|こうこう}) is not legally compulsory but is attended by almost all students.
- {前期|ぜんき}{中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}: lower secondary education ({中学校|ちゅうがっこう}).
- {後期|こうき}{中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}: upper secondary education ({高等学校|こうとうがっこう}).

REGISTER:
Formal and academic. Almost exclusively used in government documents, education policy discussions, research papers, and comparative international education statistics. In ordinary conversation, Japanese speakers simply say {中学校|ちゅうがっこう} and {高校|こうこう}.
